name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: If Hugo goes with Pumpkin, then Ristretto goes with Cara.
Edith goes with at least one of Americano, Latte, or Pumpkin.
Between Caramel and Hazelnut, one goes with Latte and the other with Ristretto.
Between Edith and Hugo, one goes with Americano and the other with Chai.
Vanilla goes with either Edith or Greta.
Exactly one of these is true: Greta goes with Hazelnut; Latte goes with Almond; Ristretto goes with Caramel.
